## Code

### P1 "00_DotTrail" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: SIMPLEST FEEDBACK TEST — draws a moving orange dot, adds it on top of the previous frame with decay. Close the loop through one other node (e.g. a light Gaussian blur): this node's output -> blur -> 'prev', with the cable into 'prev' set to Delayed. A delayed cable straight from the output to 'prev' leaves 'prev' empty, and an immediate cable anywhere in the loop drops the chain. Without the loop…; categories: Test, Feedback; inputs: prev:image, decay:float=0.97, speed:float=1

```glsl
void main()
{
  vec2 uv = isf_FragNormCoord;

  // Read previous frame and decay it slightly
  vec3 old = IMG_NORM_PIXEL(prev, uv).rgb * decay;

  // Draw a moving dot (circular path)
  vec2 dotPos = 0.5 + 0.3 * vec2(cos(TIME * speed), sin(TIME * speed));
  float d = length(uv - dotPos);
  float dotMask = smoothstep(0.03, 0.0, d);

  vec3 newCol = vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.2) * dotMask;

  // Additive blend: new dot on top of faded trail
  isf_FragColor = vec4(old + newCol, 1.0);
}
```

### P4 "Twirl" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

categories: Distortion Effect; inputs: inputImage:image, radius:float=5, amount:float=0, center:point2D=[0.5,0.5]

```glsl
const float pi = 3.14159265359;


void main (void)
{
	vec2 uv = vec2(isf_FragNormCoord[0],isf_FragNormCoord[1]);
	vec2 texSize = RENDERSIZE;
	vec2 tc = uv * texSize;
	float radius_sized = radius * max(RENDERSIZE.x,RENDERSIZE.y);
	tc -= (center * RENDERSIZE);
	float dist = length(tc);
	if (dist < radius_sized) 	{
		float percent = (radius_sized - dist) / radius_sized;
		float theta = percent * percent * amount * 2.0 * pi;
		float s = sin(theta);
		float c = cos(theta);
		tc = vec2(dot(tc, vec2(c, -s)), dot(tc, vec2(s, c)));
	}
	tc += (center * RENDERSIZE);
	vec2 loc = tc / texSize;
	vec4 color = IMG_NORM_PIXEL(inputImage, loc);

	if ((loc.x < 0.0)||(loc.y < 0.0)||(loc.x > 1.0)||(loc.y > 1.0))	{
		gl_FragColor = vec4(0.0);
	}
	else	{
		gl_FragColor = color;
	}
}
```
